geo.LINE_ID: table:len — numeric line id, shown per segment; fallback name and sort key
geo.LINE_NAME: chart-len, chart-sys, map-network, insight:longest, insight:fork, insight:cross, table:len — X_n is main line n, X_Extension<n> is an extension (shown in Hebrew, raw code in the table)
geo.YEAR: kpi:year, insight:horizon, map-network, table:len — planning target year (2050 for every segment in the current file)

geo.LENGT: insight:rounding, table:len — the same length rounded to whole km
geo.__geometry: map-network, chart-shape, table:pairs, kpi:junctions, insight:cross, insight:close, insight:extent, insight:winding, insight:fork — route lengths, straight-line distances, extent, junctions and closest approaches are measured from it
